title: Update or new build?
prompt: Trailhead 1.2 is live with `runtimeVersion` set to the `appVersion` policy. The team's list for this week is below. Select **every** change you can ship to existing 1.2 users with `eas update` alone, without a new build or store review.
hints: Ask of each change: does it touch only JavaScript and bundled assets, or does it change the compiled native app?
Anything in app.json that the stores or the OS read (icons, permission strings) is native configuration.
Four changes can go over the air.
explanation: Text, logic, new screens built from modules already in the binary, and images bundled with the JavaScript are all part of the update bundle, so they ship with `eas update`. A new native module like `expo-haptics` needs to be compiled in; the app icon and permission descriptions live in native configuration the OS reads from the installed binary. Those three need a new `version`, a production build and a store release.

copy-fix.text: Reword the empty state on the hike log to "No hikes yet. Log your first one!"
copy-fix.why: Update. It's a string in a component, part of the JavaScript bundle.

reducer-bug.text: Fix `hikesReducer` so editing a hike's date re-sorts the list.
reducer-bug.why: Update. Pure JavaScript logic, the ideal over-the-air fix.

new-screen.text: Add a yearly stats screen built only from View, Text and FlatList.
new-screen.why: Update. New screens are fine as long as every native module they use is already in the build.

add-sdk-module.text: Add `expo-haptics` so the Save button vibrates gently.
add-sdk-module.why: New build. A native module that isn't in the installed binary can't arrive in an update.

icon.text: Replace the app icon with the new logo.
icon.why: New build. The home-screen icon is part of the installed app package, not the JavaScript bundle.

permission-text.text: Clarify the location permission description in the `expo-location` plugin options.
permission-text.why: New build. Config plugin options are written into native configuration when the app is built.

new-image.text: Swap the empty-state illustration for a new PNG imported with `require()`.
new-image.why: Update. Images bundled through the JavaScript bundler are assets that updates include.
